bestBets.overview: Good race to kick off this Sunday Goulburn Cup meeting. The Chris Waller-trained GAULTIER deserves to be favourite coming off a very eye-catching first-up run at Hawkesbury. I'm not sure this is much easier, but with natural improvement he'll prove hard to beat. I have liked the trials of the Waterhouse & Bott-trained VAN HOVEN. On-speed type who should slide across from gate 10 and dictate, a proper danger. CONCRETE STORM has a race fitness advantage, encouraging fresh run and should land in a positive position from that draw. OVER THE MOUNTAIN is next best after some smart early money.

raceTips.comment: Gaultier has shown enough ability in limited starts and looks suited by this assignment, with the draw giving every chance to settle close to the speed and conserve energy for the final stages. Expecting competitive debit performances from Van Hoven &Highway Robbery coming off good trials leading in over the suitable 1400m.

bestBets.overview: Smaller field here and a competitive race on paper. Keen to back OUI FLOURISH here first up off back-to-back solid trials. They?ve been in very solid company and she should find this first-up clash a lot easier. Maps ideally and should start favourite. I liked the turn of foot that PURPLE ROSE showed last start when winning. Best ridden off speed and saved for one last crack at them, that?ll be sticky from gate 3 though. PEACE BIRD has strung back-to-back wins together, albeit the latest was far from convincing. In the mix but does need to go up another level here. PIPERITA drops significantly in class here, finds Alysha Collett and maps well enough!

raceTips.comment: Purple Rose brings the right profile for this event and has enough tactical speed to settle comfortably without doing too much work early, which should leave plenty in reserve for the finish. Peace Bird has shown ability in similar company and looks capable of making her presence felt, with a position just off the speed likely to suit her racing pattern. The Eyes Have It has been building a solid record and possesses the acceleration required to put pressure on the leaders late, while a soft run in transit would be a major advantage. Justenuffsplash is another capable runner who can improve with the right race shape, with the gelding likely to roll forward and make his own luck near the speed.

With this rain-affected track, the wider gates should play right into the hands of this horse. Solid wet-track profile and gets a hungry Gibbons in the saddle. GUY?S LAST PRIZE peaks fourth up coming off three very smart efforts. Will get back but from the draw he should angle to the outside lanes. SIMPLY NUTBUSH has been well backed in early markets. The inside draw is a knock but the booking of Schiller helps. ARANESE is next best coming off a solid last-start placing.

raceTips.comment: Guys Last Prize looks well placed to run a strong race and should have the tactical speed to settle within striking distance, giving him a chance to be saved for one late sprint. Brazen Crime has enough class to be competitive in this field and should appreciate being able to settle handy, with a clean run through the race important to his chances. Simply Nutbush has been racing honestly and can put himself into contention from the outset, with the mare likely to be prominent when the pressure goes on in the straight. Sunday has shown flashes of ability and gets another opportunity here, with an economical run behind the speed capable of bringing this runner into the finish.

bestBets.overview: Another big field here but no real speed at all to mention up front over the 1600m. The in-form MIDNIGHT AFFAIR goes on top, coming off back-to-back wins for Nick Olive. She handles all conditions and only needs to hold her recent form to win. WIN THE DAY is the danger, smart booking of Collett and handles these wet tracks well. The query is his last 50m at the end of a strong 1600m. THINK I DO can improve here second up, 7th fresh but that was only when beaten 2.6L. Right in this. NATIONAL ASSET maps well enough from gate 4, will need to land off rails and has been well backed in early markets.

raceTips.comment: Midnight Affair has the ability to take control of this race and should be able to use her natural speed to settle prominently, giving her every chance to dictate terms in the early stages. Spurline has been holding his form well and looks suited by a race where he can settle just behind the leaders, with his finishing effort likely to be strong. National Asset has enough ability to remain competitive and should benefit from finding cover in the run, allowing him to conserve his energy before making his move in the straight. Philadelphia Storm is capable of improving sharply with the right race shape and can settle closer than expected, with a genuine tempo giving the gelding his chance to finish strongly.

bestBets.overview: The ?Big Dance Eligibility? Goulburn Cup is the feature event of the day. Once again, a massive field and this time with plenty of speed to report up front. Happy to attack the race with a two-pronged approach. CROSS TASMAN is trialling up impressively and gets a lovely setup here fresh from gate 6 with this speed on. Best is at 1600m but he looks set for this 1400m clash. WATSON is the other. He has a very smart SP profile. He was a touch plain last start but I?m counting on him bouncing back here in impressive fashion. COLD BREW is the map horse and has been very well backed. 1400m is a tick now and from that gate he should get to the best lanes. JUST PARTY will need luck from an inside draw but his best runs have all come fresh. Right in the mix.

raceTips.comment: Very keen on the lightly raced and talented Cross Tasman resuming over the 1400m, has trialled strongly leading in and from the soft draw will enjoy the run of the race stalking the speed. Cold Brew is a ultra consistent gelding that has the superior early speed in the race to find the front and dictate the tempo to suit. Watson fought on well through the line over 1400m last start and is now at peak fitness, the mare will settle prominent to the pace not needing luck in running.

Brucey has enough early pace to find a favourable position and should be able to travel comfortably before being asked for the effort, making him a genuine threat late. Overshadow has shown he can be competitive when able to get the right run and should appreciate settling off the speed, with his best work expected when the pressure builds.
